cell_line.evidence: The hit compound TAK285 was subjected to full proteome profiling by TMTpro 6-plex to assess its degradation selectivity in NALM-6 cells.
For each sample, 200 µg (K562) or 100 µg (NALM-6) of protein was digested using a filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) protocol essentially according to published procedures.
